title: Time Jump: 06:00 to 13:20 MDT

fields.narration: EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE. We are moving the clock forward 7 hours and 20 minutes. It is now 13:20 MDT on Wednesday, 14 April 2027. Circuits 6, 7, 11 and 12 have been without power since 08:00, which is 5 hours and 20 minutes. The wind arrived as forecast. Coyote Ridge peaked at a 54 mile-per-hour gust at 12:40 and now reads 49. Gulch Saddle reads 51, and relative humidity is 9 percent. The Community Resource Center in the Pine Gulch Fire Station community room opened at 07:00. It has 46 visitors, most of them charging oxygen concentrators and phones. Co-op crews reached 3 of the 4 most critical medical baseline households that did not answer the phone. The fourth household, on Gulch Road, was not home and is still unconfirmed. The school district released Pine Gulch Elementary early at 13:00. Two buses are on Gulch Road now, and 31 students are still in the gym waiting for their parents. Cell tower PG-14 has been running on battery since 08:00. Well 2 is down, and the water district is supplying Pine Gulch from storage. And as of this moment, 13:20, every 911 line at the Regional Communications Center is lit. Please update your status boards to the new time.
worldState: Clock: 13:20 MDT, Wednesday 14 April 2027. The Red Flag Warning for the Sawmill County foothills runs until 20:00 MDT.
Circuits 6, 7, 11 and 12 are de-energized (since 08:00, 5 h 20 min). 3,100 customers are without power. Restoring power needs a full line patrol and gusts below 35 mph for 2 hours.
Co-op weather stations: Coyote Ridge peaked at a 54 mph gust at 12:40 and now reads 49 mph. Gulch Saddle reads 51 mph. RH is 9 percent.
Community Resource Center (Pine Gulch Fire Station community room): opened at 07:00 and has 46 visitors charging oxygen concentrators and phones. Hours are 07:00 to 21:00.

Medical baseline (71 households on the affected circuits): 62 were reached by phone before the shutoff, and door visits confirmed 3 of the 4 most-critical no-answers. That makes 65 of 71 confirmed. The fourth critical household, on Gulch Road, was not home and is UNCONFIRMED.
Pine Gulch Elementary was released early at 13:00. Two buses are on Gulch Road, and 31 students are in the gym waiting for parents to pick them up.
Cell tower PG-14 has been on battery backup since 08:00.
Pine Gulch Water District Well 2 is down, and Pine Gulch is being supplied from storage.
13:20: every 911 line at the Regional Communications Center is lit.
fields.facilitatorNote: Give players 3 to 5 minutes to reset before releasing the next inject. Watch whether the EM confirms the EOC activation level for the Red Flag Warning (EOP 5.1: Level 2) and lists the open items: the unconfirmed Gulch Road household, the remaining battery time at PG-14, and the 31 students in the gym. OPS should give the medical baseline count against the 100 percent target (6 of 71 are still not confirmed). DISP should get ready to check line status with the co-op as soon as a fire report comes in. Do not explain why the 911 lines are lit.
